_comment: Golden wire vectors for the client-facing Warren /v1 HTTP API DTOs, defined once in warren_contract::dto and served/consumed by both the backend and every SDK. Each case is the exact JSON the DTO serializes to (a tolerant reader: unknown fields are ignored, absent optionals are omitted, not null). An SDK MUST deserialize each request/response into its DTO and re-serialize to the same object. A field rename or retype breaks the deployed server or a sibling SDK silently at runtime, so these freeze the shape. Synthetic values only: pubkey_ss58 wb7uuPeV... encodes the well-known test pubkey 0707..07, the IP is an RFC 5737 documentation address.

register_account_request._note: referral_code is omitted (not null) when absent

check_response._note: exit_country and exit_city are omitted when the peer is not an exit

session_open_request._note: max_devices and the v2 token_b64 are omitted when absent

session_open_response._note: reason is omitted when admitted; pre-v2 exits pin this three-field shape
